sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Foundational Principle 1**: The scheme is administered by the **Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)** in coordination with the **Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB)**.
• **Foundational Principle 2**: The logo of the scheme is an **'Earthen Pot'**, symbolizing the preservation of the environment and the earth's resources.
• **Foundational Principle 3**: Products are evaluated based on their **'Cradle-to-Grave'** impact, covering raw material extraction, manufacturing, use, and disposal.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: Compliance with the **Environment Protection Act, 1986** and BIS quality standards is mandatory for eligibility.

items.definition: A systematic analysis of the environmental impact of a product throughout its entire life cycle, from resource extraction to final disposal.
Unlike mandatory standards (like ISI mark for safety), Eco Mark is voluntary, incentivizing manufacturers to adopt green practices for market differentiation.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Consumer Awareness**: Encourages informed choices by identifying products with minimal environmental impact.
• **Industrial Shift**: Promotes cleaner production technologies and waste reduction in manufacturing sectors.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Low consumer awareness, lack of price competitiveness, and limited product categories covered.
• **Solutions**: Integration with digital platforms (e-commerce), tax incentives for certified products, and mandatory green procurement policies.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym / Phrase**: 'E-P-B' (Earthen Pot, Pollution Control, BIS).
• **Decoded Meaning**: Earthen Pot (Logo), Pollution Control Board (Technical Criteria), BIS (Certification Authority).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses 'Eco Mark' (voluntary) with 'ISI Mark' (mandatory for safety) or 'Agmark' (agricultural quality). Eco Mark is strictly for environmental performance.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Green Nudging' to describe how Eco Mark influences consumer behavior toward sustainable consumption.

keyTakeaways: Eco Mark is a voluntary scheme under the BIS and CPCB.
The logo is an Earthen Pot, representing environmental sustainability.
It utilizes a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) approach to evaluate product impact.
